name: Yomega Darth Vader Fireball Yo-Yo
description: Yomega Darth Vader Fireball Yo-Yo: Now Star Wars and Yo-Yo fans of all ages can wield the Force like never before with Yomegas collectible new Yo-Men Action Stands. Some of the most memorable characters from the Star Wars Galaxy, come to life in this brand new way to play. Each Yomega Yo-Men character features a high-performance Fireball yo-yo emblazoned with the characters image, perfect for super-fast advanced tricks or basic throws. Place the Fireball in the Action Stand to complete the Yo-Men character. For ages 8 and up. UPC: 049871004014
